get.description: Returns the public key of the SSH Certificate Authority in OpenSSH format, for use in `TrustedUserCAKeys` on SSH servers or `@cert-authority` entries in `known_hosts` on SSH clients.

200.description: Returns SSH Certificate Authority Public Key

post.description: Issues a signed SSH user certificate for the provided public key. The request must be authenticated with an access token and include an identity token from the OIDC IdP for the same subject, along with a proof of possession of the private key. Principals on the issued certificate are derived from the identity token.

get.summary: Get the Key Revocation List for user certificates
get.description: Returns the OpenSSH Key Revocation List (KRL) of revoked user certificates issued by this CA, along with an SSHSIG signature made by the CA key so the KRL can be verified before use.

200.description: Returns an Open SSH Key Revocation List of revoked user certificates as BASE64 and an SSHSIG signature for verification

post.description: Revokes a user certificate issued by this CA, identified by its serial number, and adds it to the user Key Revocation List. The request must include a proof of possession of the private key for the public key that the certificate was issued for.

Issues a signed SSH host certificate for the provided public key and principals. The request must be authenticated with an access token and include an identity token from the OIDC IdP for the same subject, along with a proof of possession of the private key. The user must be permitted to request host certificates by email address or role.

post.description: Issues a new SSH host certificate with the same principals as an existing, unexpired and unrevoked host certificate issued by this CA. No OIDC authentication is required; instead the public key must match the existing certificate and the proof of possession must be made with its private key. The lifetime of the renewed certificate is no longer than that of the existing certificate.

get.description: Returns the OpenSSH Key Revocation List (KRL) of revoked host certificates issued by this CA, along with an SSHSIG signature made by the CA key so the KRL can be verified before use.

200.description: Returns an Open SSH Key Revocation List of revoked host certificates as BASE64 and an SSHSIG signature for verification

post.description: Revokes a host certificate issued by this CA, identified by its serial number, and adds it to the host Key Revocation List. The request must include a proof of possession of the private key for the public key that the certificate was issued for.
